description: Forecast origin date (UTC midnight). Features use data through end of this day; target looks forward.
Latitude of the 1.0 deg grid cell centroid.
Longitude of the 1.0 deg grid cell centroid.
Per-cell magnitude of completeness (MAXC + 0.2 correction), static, computed from full cell history.
Cumulative count of catalog events in this cell from the start of the catalog through day t (cell 'maturity').
Days since the most recent event in this cell, as of day t (inter-event-time proxy).
Count of events in this cell in the trailing 7-day window ending on day t (inclusive) - seismicity rate.
Mean magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 7-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
Max magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 7-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
log10(1 + sum of radiated seismic energy [Joules, via 10^(1.5*mag+4.8)] over the trailing 7-day window).
Count of events in this cell in the trailing 30-day window ending on day t (inclusive) - seismicity rate.
Mean magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 30-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
Max magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 30-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
log10(1 + sum of radiated seismic energy [Joules, via 10^(1.5*mag+4.8)] over the trailing 30-day window).
Count of events in this cell in the trailing 90-day window ending on day t (inclusive) - seismicity rate.
Mean magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 90-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
Max magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 90-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
log10(1 + sum of radiated seismic energy [Joules, via 10^(1.5*mag+4.8)] over the trailing 90-day window).
Count of events in this cell in the trailing 365-day window ending on day t (inclusive) - seismicity rate.
Mean magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 365-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
Max magnitude of events in this cell in the trailing 365-day window. NaN if no events in the window.
log10(1 + sum of radiated seismic energy [Joules, via 10^(1.5*mag+4.8)] over the trailing 365-day window).
Gutenberg-Richter b-value (Aki/Utsu MLE) over the trailing 90-day window, using events >= mc_cell. NaN if fewer than 10 qualifying events in the window (unreliable estimate).
Number of events >= mc_cell used in the 90-day b-value estimate (reliability indicator for b_value_90d).
Gutenberg-Richter b-value (Aki/Utsu MLE) over the trailing 365-day window, using events >= mc_cell. NaN if fewer than 10 qualifying events in the window (unreliable estimate).
Number of events >= mc_cell used in the 365-day b-value estimate (reliability indicator for b_value_365d).
sin(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) - cyclical seasonal encoding.
